metadata.description: Educational plugin marketplace for Claude Code Mastering training. Four plugins demonstrating skills, hooks, agents, and combined patterns.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Code quality skills: review, refactoring suggestions, and naming convention checks. Demonstrates multi-skill plugins and $ARGUMENTS usage.

plugins.name: git-guardian
plugins.description: Git safety guardrails using hooks to prevent destructive operations and log file changes. Demonstrates hooks.json, PreToolUse blocking, and PostToolUse messaging.

plugins.name: team-standards
plugins.description: Team coding standards enforcer with a custom agent, supporting skills, and settings. Demonstrates agents + skills + settings working together.

plugins.name: project-bootstrap
plugins.description: Full-featured project scaffolding combining skills, hooks, agents, and settings. Demonstrates all plugin capabilities together.
